title: 第十五章 诗兴大发第十六章 开诚布公
content_zh:
我在恐怖伊万的怀抱里憋得喘不过气来，好不容易挣脱了他的熊抱：“吓死爹了！”
这一句将其他人都给弄到发笑。
这个可爱的伊万还懵逼的问：“他说什么，大家都在笑？爹是什么？好吃吗？”
这家伙的懵逼的样子和全部第四声的发音让大家笑得更厉害了。
中文的博大精深，就连我们有时候也不会理解，还有很多字都不会读不会写呢，何况这些歪果仁，但是不得不承认的是，伊万说的普通话还是很容易听懂的，虽然都是第四声。
我心里想：还好，原来我昨晚的梦不是真的，但是是不是有其他意思呢？有时候人就是这样，求证了一个设想后却力图再用其他方式来求证这个被求证的设想是不是正确的，结果就是陷入了在恐慌下走出原始森林的左脚理论：兜兜转转以为走出了原始森林却莫名的回到了原点，以为撞了邪，其实是因为自己的左腿比右腿长那么一丁点儿，因此走着走着就做了个圆周运动回到原点。
中年人的患得患失。
或者说是自己的患得患失，让自己的思绪总是陷入左腿理论。
人生想要活得美，就得删繁就简，去掉多余的东西，蔡志忠说：“每一块木头都成为一尊佛，只要去掉多余的部分。”
我想甩掉我这种想得太多、同时又患得患失的心魔。
成就强大的自己，不是要从年轻时候就开始做的，我觉得要成就强大的自己，是从你自己真正觉悟要改变自己的那一刻开始。
我对小强说：“小强，我想去这座山的最高处，喏，就是刚才伊万攀岩的那个位置。”
没待小强出声回应我，这个既恐怖又可爱的伊万抢先发声：“我带大家去。”
大家都跟着他往上走，其实从土匪窝到山顶，也就那么百十米的距离，经历过刚才恐怖伊万的心跳之举，我已经没有了什么承受不了的行为了。
心里像织毛衣般细腻耐心的将石屋和待会悬崖酒店的主线在重新串联。
从北面水库吹来的风明显的比从南面吹来的风细腻温柔，一种更柔美的感觉，南面的风从海上来，带着一丝咸味，就像一个粗鲁的汉子，北面的风却像一个温柔的女子。
刚走了没两分钟，从山顶方向远远的朝我们走来一个熟悉的身影，在山上高高低低的杂草和矮树里若隐若现。
紫萱说：“那是矮仔成吗？”
我手搭凉棚看了看：“是啊，真像呢！
不过他不是说他要接待大客户吗？”

三斤姐的思路一直都和她化妆的思路一样的严谨按顺序：“就算是矮仔成，他也是应该出现在我们的后面而不是对面。”
应验拍摄着这一切没出声。
对于摄影师来说，边拍摄便出声不是一个好的选项，太危险了。
他专注拍摄的样子很是吸引人，做事情就该这样，心无旁骛。
小强说：“那是我哥，没错了。
他怎么又上来了？”
紫萱问：“他飞上来的吗？”
小陈说：“他个子不叫矮仔成，那叫长腿叔叔。
一伸腿就上来了。”
小强说：“他是从山的另一边上来的，那边相对这里比较好走。”
我就对小强说：“刚才你也可以待我们从那边，是西边爬上来啊！”
小强愣了一下，很不自然的说：“啊，那边要那个啥。
哎，还是东边这里好，你不是刚刚说了一通大石头的设想吗？”
我一见他这样的表情，心存疑惑却不知所出。
矮仔成在山顶不走了，只是朝我们挥挥手，我们几个见状便加快了步伐，几分钟后在山顶汇合了，这样的汇合，怎么看怎么像井冈山的汇合似的，这样的场景，应验也没有拉下。
content_en:
I was so suffocated in the arms of Horrible Ivan that I finally broke free from his bear hug: "Dad was scared to death!"
This sentence made everyone else laugh.
This cute Ivan still asked in confusion: "What did he say and everyone is laughing? What is daddy? Is it delicious?"
The guy's confused look and his pronunciation of all fourth tones made everyone laugh even harder.
Chinese is so broad and profound that even we sometimes can’t understand it, and there are still many words that we can’t read or write, let alone these crooked nuts. But we have to admit that Ivan’s Mandarin is still easy to understand, even though it’s all in the fourth tone.
I thought to myself: Fortunately, it turns out that my dream last night was not real, but does it have other meanings? Sometimes people are like this. After verifying an assumption, they try to use other methods to verify whether the verified assumption is correct. As a result, they fall into the left-foot theory of walking out of the primitive forest in panic: they go round and round thinking they have walked out of the primitive forest but inexplicably return to the starting point. They think they have hit an evil spirit. In fact, it is because their left leg is a little longer than the right leg, so they make a circular motion back to the starting point while walking.
Middle-aged people worry about gains and losses.
In other words, it is because I am worried about gains and losses, which makes my mind always fall into the left leg theory.
If you want to live a beautiful life, you have to simplify it and get rid of the superfluous things. Cai Zhizhong said: "Every piece of wood becomes a Buddha, just get rid of the superfluous parts."
I want to get rid of my inner demon of overthinking and worrying about gains and losses at the same time.
To become a strong self, you don’t have to start from a young age. I think that to become a strong self, it starts from the moment you truly realize that you want to change yourself.
I said to Xiaoqiang: "Xiaoqiang, I want to go to the highest point of this mountain. Here, it is the place where Ivan climbed just now."
Before Xiaoqiang could respond to me, this scary yet adorable Ivan spoke first: "I'll take everyone there."
Everyone followed him up. In fact, the distance from the bandits' den to the top of the mountain was only a hundred or ten meters. After experiencing Ivan's heart-pounding action just now, there was nothing I couldn't bear anymore.
My mind was as delicate and patient as knitting a sweater, reconnecting the main thread between the stone house and the Cliff Hotel.
The wind blowing from the reservoir in the north is obviously more delicate and gentle than the wind blowing from the south, with a more gentle feeling. The wind from the south comes from the sea, with a hint of salty taste, like a rude man, but the wind from the north is like a gentle woman.
Just two minutes after walking, a familiar figure walked towards us from a distance from the top of the mountain, looming among the weeds and short trees high and low on the mountain.
Zixuan said: "Is that a short boy?"
I put up a pergola with my hands and looked at it: “Yes, it really looks like it!
But didn’t he say he was going to receive big customers? "
Sister Sanjin's thinking has always been as rigorous and sequential as her makeup thinking: "Even if it's a short guy, he should appear behind us instead of opposite."
Yingyi filmed all this without making a sound.
For photographers, making noise while shooting is not a good option, it is too dangerous.
The way he concentrates on shooting is very attractive, and he does things just like he should, without any distractions.
Xiaoqiang said: "That's my brother, that's right.
Why did he come up again? "
Zixuan asked: "Did he fly up here?"
Xiao Chen said: "If he is not called Short Boy, he is called Daddy Long Legs.
He came up as soon as he stretched his legs. "
Xiaoqiang said: "He came up from the other side of the mountain, which is easier to walk than here."
I said to Xiaoqiang: "You could have waited for us to climb up from the west side just now!"
Xiaoqiang was stunned for a moment and said unnaturally: "Ah, what do you want over there?
Hey, it’s better to be here in the east. Didn’t you just talk about the idea of ​​the big stone? "
When I saw his expression like this, my heartI have doubts but don’t know where to start.
Azai Cheng stopped walking at the top of the mountain and just waved to us. When we saw this, we quickened our pace and met at the top of the mountain a few minutes later. This meeting looked like the meeting in Jinggang Mountain, and this scene did not come true.
